skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand and use terminology related to Public Relations in both English and Vietnamese.

skill_outcomes.skill_name: History and Evolution of Public Relations
skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand the historical development and evolution of Public Relations.
Understand ethical considerations and the role of professional bodies in Public Relations.
Understand the Public Relations process including planning, implementation, and evaluation.
Understand the diverse global work environment and cultural nuances across countries.
Understand professional expectations and ethics in Public Relations within developed countries.
Collaborate effectively with team members to complete tasks in English.
Use foreign languages proficiently in Public Relations tasks such as communication, reading, writing, presentations, and report writing.
